It has lower health than most enemies it spawns alongside with, however, it is way faster than all of them. It has [[Shield Health]] which, once depleted, causes the shield its holding to break, more than halving its speed and removing its [[Defense]]. ==Logbook Description== "''Void Rushers are created once Swifts earn their ranking and are promoted into carrying the Shield of the Void. How they go about choosing who is and who is not fit for the title is unknown, but once they pick up the shield it is forbidden to place it down. The shield weighs more than their own bodies, yet even that is lighter than the burden of holding the frontline of the Void.''" ==Appearance== The '''Void Rusher''' has black skin and purple markings on its body. It wears purple armor on its torso and legs and also has a purple helmet. It carries the Shield of the Void which is destroyed when its [[Shield Health]] is depleted. ==Strategy== *Depleting the '''Void Rusher's''' [[Shield Health]] as fast as possible is crucial to dramatically slowing it down before it becomes a major threat. **Utilizing high DPS towers such as the [[Engineer]], [[Accelerator]], [[Juggernaut]] or [[Kingpin]] can quickly drain the '''Void Rusher's''' [[Shield Health]]. **The [[Commander]] and [[Medic]] can decrease the firerate of your towers, allowing them to kill the '''Void Rusher''' faster. ***The [[DJ Booth]] can also increase your towers' range to cover more path. *Because of its extremely swift speed, using towers such as the [[Electroshocker]], [[Tesla]], [[Freezer]] or [[Frost Blaster]] can slow down the '''Void Rusher'''. **In addition, defense melting towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Frost Blaster]] or [[Golden Pyromancer]] can decrease the high [[Defense]] of the '''Void Rusher'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.2.0GenericThumbnail15.png|'''Void Rusher''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} VoidRusherCA.png|'''Void Rusher''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ModernVoidRusherIconIG.png|'''Void Rusher''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Void Rusher''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Void Rusher''' added, replacing the [[Fallen Rusher (Legacy)|Fallen Rusher]]. {{Hardcore|[[Mandragora]]|Wave 26|Void Rusher|Wave 27|[[Void Pike]]|Wave 28}} {{Voidcore|[[Void Floater]]|Wave 25|Void Rusher|Wave 27|[[Void Pike]]|Wave 28}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
